title: App Studio 改版（3-2）：「全部软件包」目录 ~all 搬到设置的访问分组，Studio 不再有这个入口
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbL6Nn3scsU8yvLyU4

Filing gate: ③ · Source: `docs/adr/0084` on main, `#amendment-2026-11-26-moves`. Question 5 was ruled: `~all` goes to an access-related Setup group, not to Diagnostics (record 7187264388 on #37451). The maintainer asked at 2026-11-26 13:25Z to move phase 3 forward. Sub-issue of #37424 (phase 3).
Grade: area:ux · Feature · p2 · evidence: the Studio `~all` scope (the all-packages directory) is drawn from `studio-design/**` and routed in the console.
Reader: area `ux-37424`.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：跨所有软件包的「全部目录」搬出 Studio，放到「设置」里和访问相关的分组下。Studio 只用来开发一个软件包。
- 为什么：Studio 开发一个包，设置管整个组织和全局内容（专题第 12 条，你已同意）。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What

- Add the cross-package directory as a Setup page, in the group that holds the access pages. Pick the exact entry by reading `setup-nav.contributions.ts`, and name it in the PR.
- Retire the Studio `~all` entry. An old `~all` address redirects once to the new Setup page, using the same redirect pattern as `setupMetadataRedirect.ts`.
- The page keeps today's access rule: opening it from Setup must not widen who sees it.
- Each row links to the item's editor in its own package in Studio.
- On the PR, answer the open question in #37424 comment 7188504633 (a): does the directory still list `datasource` once the menu draws no row for it?

## Acceptance

- Setup shows the directory under the access group, Studio has no `~all` entry, and an old `~all` link lands on the Setup page.
- Existing `~all` tests are re-pointed, not weakened. Screenshots attached.
